title: Dashboards
text:
Candy Dashboard
Examines the 538 Candy Ranking data from 2017.
Bars vs. Bags
Do people prefer candy bars or bags of candy pieces?
Penguins Dashboard
Uses the palmerpenguins package and offers an exploratory look at the data.
NCAA D1 Women’s Basketball Dashboard
Uses the SportsDataverse, wehoop R package. Explores the 2025-2026 women’s basketball season and how 3-point shooting has changed over the seasons.
